caption: A laser pointer's beam enters a tank of slightly milky water at an angle, and the beam bends where it crosses the surface.

sa.check: A laser pointer's beam enters a tank of slightly milky water at an angle.
The beam bends where it crosses the surface.
The beam is straight in the air and straight in the water.
The kink moves with the entry point.

pc.expect: The beam is straight in the air and in the water and kinks only at the surface, bending toward the vertical.
pc.fail: The beam curves in the air; or in the water; or passes straight through the surface with no kink at an angle.

pc.expect: The kink moves with the entry point and there would be no bend if the beam were aimed straight down.
pc.fail: The kink stays put while the entry point moves; or it bends the wrong way; or it splits into two beams.

pc.expect: The beam moves only with the pointer.
pc.fail: It drifts with the pointer still; or flickers; or jumps.

pc.expect: The water surface is level and the beam is visible in the milky water.
pc.fail: The surface tilts and holds; or the beam is invisible in the water; or the water is rigid.

pc.expect: One pointer, one beam and one tank.
pc.fail: A second beam appears; or the tank vanishes; or the beam becomes solid.

pc.expect: The tank and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The tank changes shape; or the room rearranges; or the beam changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
